title: Claim: Scarlettgroup ransomware group lists CHU de Bordeaux hospital on its leak site
summary: The ransomware group Scarlettgroup listed CHU de Bordeaux on its leak site on 22 November, claiming patient and staff data, according to Cyberattaque.org. The site says the claimed volume is unknown, no sample was checked, and the hospital has not confirmed data theft.
plain: A criminal group says it stole data from Bordeaux's university hospital. The claim has not been confirmed by the hospital.
exec: Unconfirmed extortion claim against a major French hospital; no confirmed data theft so far.

validation.note: Leak-site claim (Scarlettgroup, listed 22 Nov per Cyberattaque.org, which read the listing and a screenshot). Sud Ouest also reports the claim but its page could not be loaded here. No hospital statement read; Cyberattaque.org says the CHU has not confirmed data theft.
